stem:
Farhan takes the same school bag from Earth to the Moon. Gravity is weaker on the Moon than on Earth.

Which statement about the bag is correct?

options.text: Its mass stays the same; its weight decreases.
Its mass decreases; its weight decreases.
Its mass stays the same; its weight stays the same.
Its mass decreases; its weight stays the same.

teacher.key_rationale: Mass is the amount of matter and does not change with place. Weight depends on gravity, so it is smaller on the Moon. B treats mass as if it depended on gravity. C ignores the gravity change for weight. D reverses which quantity changes.
